### The Best Way to Start Your Everyday
Author: Jonathan Parnell
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-best-way-to-start-your-everyday
Passage: Psalm 143:8
Points:
- Every day consists of taking things in and putting things out: receptivity and productivity.
- Believers awaken into spiritual warfare and pressing circumstances, much like David did.
- David models meeting the morning by asking to hear of God's steadfast covenant love.
- Resting first in gospel grace anchors the soul against the lies of the enemy.
- Asking God for guidance renounces self-reliance and yields the day's actions to His sovereign direction.
